claims_excluded: hard real-time bound beyond the frozen finite windows

decision.fail_or_unknown: any mismatch, absent hook entry, uncertain call ID, completed dispatch before cancel, extra dispatch/cancel/recovery, unknown release/readback, timeout, effect mismatch, or incomplete cleanup; preserve raw and do not rerun.
decision.pass: exactly one dispatch and one cancel; observed generation matches owned fixture; hook confirms injected Q-down inside callback; public cancel returns without error within 1000ms while same-call result reports running; during the full 1250ms callback hold, same-call polling reports recovered and release_confirmed=true; only then does a separately spawned process observe same-generation Q-up before callback return; final result binds recovery to the same operation/generation, exact producer exit precedes one recovery UP, a second same-generation all-up readback completes within 2500ms; saved fixture effect and exact pre-cancel journal match; hook, fixture, session and child cleanup are confirmed.

host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
hypothesis: After a public stdio-MCP cancellation, Windows low-level hook timeout permits exact producer retirement and supervised recovery before the original native callback returns; a separate-process Q-state readback triggered by recovered/release-confirmed must then observe same-generation Q-up within the 1250ms held interval.
resource_boundary: Only this PC and one owned fixture. Hold the first injected VK_Q callback for 1250ms after cancel response; callback self-release cap remains 1500ms. Read the current-user LowLevelHooksTimeout registry value without changing it. No WSLc or Docker. Restore prior foreground HWND.
retry_policy: one validation and at most one public dispatch; retrieve its call ID from the zero-wait response; issue one cancel only after hook entry and a same-call running readback; no fallback input, replay, retry, or rerun

admission.target_generation: exact generation returned by this attempt public interface_observe

trial.cancel: one public interface_cancel for the exact dispatch call_id; no second cancel
trial.effect_order: fixture click, sentinel text and CTRL+S save happen before the Q-down cancellation point; task effect is read independently after the recovery flow.

native_stimulus.hook: one WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook in the probe process
native_stimulus.release: Keep the first injected Q-down inside the hook callback for 1250ms after public cancel response. Take an initial independent Q-state sample, then spawn a second independent same-generation sample only after same-call recovered/release_confirmed; release only after the frozen hold or on the callback 1500ms self-deadline.

trial.pre_cancel_readback: After hook entry, interface_results must show action status running before one interface_cancel call.
trial.target: one fresh owned fixture process/window; exact call_id obtained from the public zero-wait pending-or-terminal dispatch response
